title: Profile — multi structure tags (Select2, existing tags only)
summary: Profile create/edit uses Select2 multi-select for optional structure tags from the Structure module (project-scoped). Project is required; auto-create structure on profile save removed. Tags stored in profile_structure_tags junction table.

items: Profile::structureTagsForProfile / saveStructureTags / validation against existing tags in location
Structure::byOwner and linked PAPS queries use junction table
profile/form.js gated on project + municipality + barangay; clears tags when location changes
profile/form.php Select2 multi + preview list under select
Select2 tag dropdown shows Tag #, Structure ID, Classification columns
Profile view Structure tab: removed Add structure; table includes Classification column
Structure list: Classification column; view Status History for tagging status
profile_structure_tags array on read/write; legacy profile_structure_tag kept on read
tag-search and profile structures list return classification_label
